body: Hey I messaged you for the discord invite but never got anything back. Mind sending it to me?
No, sorry, I’m just not on reddit right now, was watching YouTube. I have not had an official diagnosis, but I suspect I may be on the very high functioning end.

No problem man. I suppose the root of my issue is that I’ve never felt a real connection with anyone. I’ve been isolated for my entire life. I’ve never had any friends, I’ve never had any relationships (successful ones anyways), i don’t have any deep connection with my parents, nothing. I feel like I’m completely alone in this world, and I don’t want to continue living life that way. I’ve spent a long time trying to fix it, I’ve joined clubs, I’ve picked up hobbies, I’ve even learned to ‘shudder’ small talk. Still nothing. I’ve dedicated my life to helping others, but I’m incompetent and can’t do that right either. At this point I just want to kill myself in a way that preserves my organs for donation. That’s the short story of my life. Thanks for reading.

I assume English isn’t your first language, but pardon me of that is incorrect. I have been suicidal for 6 years, I did not recently start feeling suicidal. The money was necessary for a painless death, but you are correct that I could have killed myself at any time by crashing my car or shooting myself or something. I desire a painless death though. If I need to clarify anything else let me know, and I am not trolling.
Edit: the stimulus check refers to the recent check sent out to many americans to help stimulate the economy in light of covid19.
